rfm_segments.name: Champions / High Value
rfm_segments.description: High spenders with frequent, recent purchases. High brand affinity and low churn risk.
rfm_segments.strategy: VIP rewards, early access to new product drops, personalized white-glove support.

rfm_segments.name: Loyal Customers
rfm_segments.description: Steady regular buyers with above-average order totals and strong loyalty tier representation.
rfm_segments.strategy: Upsell category expansion, loyalty points acceleration, cross-sell bundles.

rfm_segments.name: Potential Loyalists
rfm_segments.description: Recent shoppers with moderate frequency and spending. Promising lifetime value potential.
rfm_segments.strategy: Time-sensitive discount incentives, welcome series recommendations, targeted free shipping.

rfm_segments.name: At-Risk / Churned
rfm_segments.description: Infrequent buyers who have not purchased in over 4-6 months. Require re-activation.
rfm_segments.strategy: Win-back email campaigns, survey feedback requests, deep clearance vouchers.
